What to do next

Internal team or producer

Address findings, run curbpack check, then review the source changes before sharing. Use curbpack review --repo . to check document references.

Buyer or insurer

Confirm the intended product, version and use. Request the referenced evidence, support commitments and unresolved risks. Decide whether more evidence is needed before a purchase or coverage decision.

Reviewer or auditor

Check the received folder, inspect the supporting evidence, and record your findings. Matching hashes do not establish producer identity, complete product evidence or applicability.

Agent or automation

Use curbpack check --json for gates and curbpack review review-pack --json for separate trust results. Preserve exit codes. Leave approval and signing to a person.

Keep the whole received folder together. From its parent directory, run:

curbpack review review-pack

If the folder has another name, substitute that name. A single HTML file is a reading copy, not a complete verifiable pack. If Curbpack is not installed, ask your technical reviewer to run this check.

How to interpret verification
  • Integrity: run review to check whether included files match their manifest.
  • Authenticity: No verified signer. This unsigned report does not establish who produced it.
  • Completeness: review checks declared files only, not all product evidence.
  • Applicability: you must establish whether this product, policy and date match your intended use.

This page cannot verify its own contents. Use the CLI on the received folder.
